name: Cartoon Character Maker - Now with dualstrusion!

captions.detailed: This 3D model depicts a stylized, low-poly human avatar head. It features distinct facial elements including rectangular hipster-style glasses, rounded eyes looking slightly upward, a pointed nose, small ears, and an open mouth. The entire head is tilted slightly backward on a short cylindrical neck, showing a faceted surface texture due to its low-resolution rendering.
captions.instruction: Create a highly customizable, parametric 3D avatar head in OpenSCAD. The design must allow users to adjust the overall height, head tilt, facial proportions (top and bottom width), and neck thickness, as well as customize features like hair style, eye type, nose shape, mouth expression, and glasses, with options to output as a single solid or split parts for dual-extrusion printing.
captions.factory: The script constructs the main head shape using a hull operation between two spheres (representing the top and bottom of the head) inside a 'head' module. Boolean difference operations are used to carve out the mouth using a 'mouth_blank' module made of a scaled cylinder. The eyes, nose, ears, and glasses are positioned using mathematical translations and rotations based on parametric variables, and the final assembly is scaled, tilted, and optionally sliced flat at the bottom using a cube difference.
